articles.title: Striped Bass Are in Trouble, and Anglers Are Worried
articles.summary: Striped bass are struggling after years of poor reproduction in Chesapeake Bay, and anglers and scientists worry stricter fishing limits may be needed to protect the fish and the jobs that depend on them.

articles.title: Tech Stocks Fall as Investors Want Proof on AI Spending
articles.summary: On October 30, 2026, tech stocks fell sharply as investors worried AI excitement had pushed prices too high, while some oil stocks rose after stronger summer profits.

articles.title: Binance Works to Recover Billions After Major Hack
articles.summary: Binance said about $3 billion of stolen digital assets had been secured, while it works with investigators to recover the rest and says it will cover customer losses.
